title: External Validation of a Widely Implemented Proprietary Sepsis Prediction Model in Hospitalized Patients
supports_claim: External validation at Michigan Medicine found the Epic Sepsis Model reached an area under the curve of 0.63, missed 67 percent of sepsis patients and still alerted on 18 percent of hospitalizations.
limitations: One United States academic health system and a retrospective design; the study does not cover how other hospitals tuned the same model locally.

title: Dissecting racial bias in an algorithm used to manage the health of populations
supports_claim: A widely used health risk algorithm scored Black patients as healthier than equally sick White patients because it predicted health care cost instead of illness.
limitations: One commercial algorithm at one United States hospital; the cost proxy mechanism does not transfer automatically to a Vietnamese triage workflow.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
supports_claim: NIST organizes voluntary AI risk management around Govern, Map, Measure and Manage, and treats measurement and monitoring as continuous obligations.
limitations: Voluntary framework only; it is not a legal classification and it certifies nothing.

title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Vietnam's AI Law took effect on 2026-03-01 and sets the legal scope that a health triage assistant deployed in Vietnam has to be mapped against.
limitations: The exact obligations depend on the provider or deployer role, the use case and the implementing instruments.

title: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg on the list of high-risk artificial intelligence systems
supports_claim: The decision publishes Vietnam's official high-risk AI list, effective 2026-08-15, which is the list a triage assistant must be checked against.
limitations: A use case has to be matched against the full official list; the title alone is not enough to classify a product.

title: Regulatory framework for artificial intelligence and the AI Act implementation timeline
supports_claim: The Commission lists emergency triage and dispatch of first response services among the Annex III high-risk areas and publishes the staged application timeline.
limitations: Guidance and application dates can still change, and the medical device question is handled by a separate legal regime.

title: Law 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection
supports_claim: Vietnam's personal data protection regime treats health data as sensitive personal data, which drives the consent, retention and vendor transfer requirements for symptom transcripts.
limitations: The published date could not be confirmed from the portal listing, and the detailed duties sit in the implementing decree rather than the law text.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile (NIST AI 600-1)
supports_claim: The generative AI profile names confabulation, harmful recommendations and information integrity as risks that need pre-deployment testing and continuous monitoring.
limitations: It describes risk categories and suggested actions, not a pass or fail test for a clinical product.
